summary: A modular synthesizer firmware: each patch is a virtual Eurorack of modules joined by cables, built and played on the FM-1 or in a web editor that sounds the same.
features: 56 modules: VCOs, ladder and Buchla-style filters, Turing, Marbles, chaos, effects
Add modules and cables on the device; rack view shows every cable
64 patterns of 64 steps per patch, piano roll, drum grid and songs
Live recording with count-in, free-tempo takes, quantize and undo
MIDI LEARN maps stored in the patch; USB audio and MIDI, TRS MIDI
33 factory patches, oscilloscope and animated visuals; one delay, reverb and chorus per patch
